public.title: Single Number
public.description: values contains an odd number of integers, from 1 to 3001 entries. Exactly one value appears once and every other distinct value appears exactly twice. Values lie between -1000000 and 1000000. Return the value that appears once.
hints: Equal values cancel under bitwise XOR.
The chosen integer range fits signed 32-bit arithmetic.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: XOR all entries: paired values cancel and the unique value remains. O(n) time and O(1) space.
